exclusion_rule: XY shared by more than one route (here the common start point) is excluded from VALID and TEST roles; pre-existing LORO exploratory numbers still contain it (1 of 2815 route sites)

TEST_blind.kind: NEW physical sites, generated by the validated on-demand Legacy backend AFTER freezing this file
TEST_blind.region: x in [1.5,18.5] m, |y| <= 0.70 m, rejected if within 0.05 m of any existing route site (same XY tag) or horizontal distance to an anchor < 0.30 m
TEST_blind.yaw: uniform [-180,180) deg per site, one yaw per site
TEST_blind.scene: same corridor scene (a different scene is NOT available -> GENERALIZATION_NOT_VERIFIED)

weights: primary = site-weighted: mean over (case, site) groups of the group MSE
leakage_rule: TEST truth is read only by the scorer after predictions are saved
